description: Workflow coaching: analyze session transcript on Stop, inject suggestions on SessionStart. Plan mode is carried by two hooks, because it has two moments that matter: UserPromptSubmit tells /dev:dev to ENTER plan mode at the architecture phase, and PostToolUse:ExitPlanMode tells it to RESUME at Phase 4 once the user approves. Both are hooks rather than text in dev.md because DPM-1 measured the in-command version reaching the model zero times in five sessions. The phase-artifact gate runs on Stop (--stop); its old PreToolUse:TaskUpdate trigger was DELETED, not kept as a fallback, because the task-list tools no longer exist on Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 5 and newer and a registration that cannot fire only advertises enforcement that is not happening.
